notes.title: NEW PATCH OUT 1.03!
notes.content:
Welcome back to Enchanted Portals!

We are pleased to announce that we have been working hard to improve the gaming experience for all our players. As always, we're listening closely to your feedback and suggestions to make sure Enchanted Portals is the best game it can be.

In our latest update, we have added a lot of new sound effects. Now, players can enjoy an even more immersive gaming experience thanks to new sounds.

Additionally, we have added a new option to select Penny when playing in single player. Now you can play with your favorite character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/76204416fe30e9d40de8cf94855acbd5d2a59032.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/4ab255bc99056ca7d31ed310d9a38fa1da751927.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy these new features as much as we enjoy improving the game for you. Thank you for playing Enchanted Portals and for being part of our gaming community!

notes.content:

notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS OUT!
notes.content:
NEW PATCH RELEASE 1.02!

·The spell change system has been revamped. Spells can now be changed instantly and you can switch midair using a single button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/d91cf7d4c4166a476ee36a60d4ae0324fc3b82bd.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/c5872a7e7713289cd692429d57828a753533cdc5.gif[/img]

· Perform actions with minimal delay between spell and action

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/5e35a0522cf1bf690e3c5e54bc64bb7dca5ddae7.gif[/img]

· Increased invulnerability time to 2 seconds after being hit

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/1bdc3621d90dd7d695a44c6ae2bc8a171ab9c56e.gif[/img]

· The direction of your dash can be changed to make it easier to adjust your fall. You can also use double jump to adjust your fall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/74053a96f21a773fffeafc6b283f56e0e663b101.gif[/img]

· Some enemies in the jungle level will now drop health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/fab2482758757bce75599cd29df9987d79fb7c93.gif[/img]

· The second phase of the witch boss has been adjusted to improve balance.

· You can now use D-pad as movement.

· Collisions on enemies and projectiles have been improved for a smoother gameplay experience.

· Players will no longer be sent back to the first level when reaching the second level of the hotel.

We hope these changes enhance your gaming experience!

notes.title: News about the next patch
notes.content:
We thank all our players for their feedback. We will adjust the game so that everyone can enjoy the best possible experience.

A patch is currently under development and will be available soon.

In the meantime, we would like to clarify some of the elements of the game that have caused confusion.

The "Turbo" mode that was recently added to choose from the menu is a special mode that increases the overall speed of the game for those who found the game to be a bit too slow. Players will be able to choose the one that best suits their playing style.

INSANE difficulty does not have any checkpoints at the moment, but in the upcoming patch progress will be saved per world.

Thank you for playing Enchanted Portals!

notes.title: ENCHANTED PORTALS IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]ENCHANTED PORTALS IS AVAILABLE NOW![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/76e96ff29d51628361c3d3fb5102ddbe23ae3c33.gif[/img]


Get ready for an adventure like no other as rookie magicians Bobby and Penny find themselves stuck between dimensions. As they journey through a variety of enchanting worlds, it’s up to you to help them fight their way back to their own dimension and reclaim the Magic Book.

With catchy music, charming old-timey art, and non-stop comedy, Enchanted Portals is a co-op 2D platformer that will keep you on your toes. Whether you’re playing solo or with a friend, the magic never stops and the action is always fast-paced and whimsical. Join Bobby and Penny on their quest and see where the adventure takes you!

* CO-OP and SOLO modes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/c2343cb03f9cd426dd3444fd2f4f4b42cb0213a6.png[/img]
* A collection of challenging PLATFORM STAGES, set in a variety of worlds across dimensions.
* Thrilling BOSS BATTLES: each featuring a colorful unique setting and multiple different phases to go through.
* A powerful arsenal of SPELLS and MOVES: fire, ice and wind ready to use from the very beginning, a handy double-jump for extra air control, a magic bubble that blocks any attack, and the ability to fly with your broom and swim underwater.
* Players can be affected by a variety of STATUS EFFECTS: jump restriction, inability to attack… all of which will pose an extra challenge and spice up the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152890/9af196ce4a5b8ce24604dd393f6b52ff83a76d9d.gif[/img]
